stylePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 3:2 illustration for a Chinese psychological horror investigation game set inside an aging 1990s apartment on the 29th floor. Painterly gouache and charcoal, worn paper texture, low saturation grey olive green, cold window light and subtle aged ochre lamp light, deep but readable shadows, subtle unsettling atmosphere, careful natural proportions. No text, no UI, no borders, no collage, no gore, no jump scare. Cinematic composition, main subject in central 70% safe for 16:9 cropping.

subjects.night-door: Night knocking: closed apartment door viewed from inside, chain lock and old brass handle, cold blue grey moonlight under the door, shadow of a woman on the other side visible beneath the threshold.
subjects.cat-bedroom: A black house cat sits on the edge of an unmade bed at night staring intently toward the viewer, dim open bedroom door and open window behind, subtly too long shadow, recognizable normal cat but disquieting gaze.
subjects.radio: Close view of a dusty vintage tabletop radio on a wooden cabinet, red ball of yarn lying beside it, wavering warm light, a faint corridor reflected in radio glass, no readable letters.
subjects.neighbor: In a dim apartment corridor a middle aged man wearing a dark old coat stands with his back toward us, his head turned impossibly enough to reveal a restrained unsettling smile in profile. Distant doorway, no exaggerated monster.
subjects.white-light: A neglected corner beside a closed wooden wardrobe, dust and a thin cold white vertical gleam low in the dark corner, as if something is quietly watching from the darkness. No face, subtle menace.
subjects.mother: A human mother in a faded blue blouse stands in the apartment living room holding a plain bowl of rice. Her face remains obscured by soft shadow, her posture too still. Empty sofa in foreground, warm kitchen light behind.
subjects.mirror: An antique rectangular mirror on a peeling grey green wall reflects an empty sofa, a dim lampshade, and an extra indistinct human silhouette standing with its back turned, but nobody stands in the room itself.
subjects.window: Close view of a tall apartment window on the 29th floor, clouded blue grey sky and distant city far below. Condensation, a few faint fingerprints on the exterior glass, subtle bodiless shadow, sheer faded curtains.
subjects.kitchen: An old apartment kitchen counter with a glass filled with dark water, refrigerator with pale blank food labels, a damp handprint near the sink. Faded tiles, no modern appliances, uneasy still life.
subjects.notes: A worn diary open on a wooden table beside an aged folded handwritten note and red yarn. Indistinct illegible ink marks, rough paper edges, faint warm lamplight, dark closed wardrobe blurred in background.
subjects.bed: Low angle view of an old bed and pillow, a small depression on the blanket as if somebody just left, faint footprints in dust beneath the bed, black cat hairs on the pillow. No visible person.
subjects.clock: An old phone with softly glowing indistinct clock interface next to a paper calendar and a broken analog wall clock, all numbers blurred and unreadable, aged wallpaper. An extra empty square on the calendar, quiet uncertainty.
subjects.wardrobe: Close view of a closed old wooden wardrobe, three faint scratches at its base, a small blue fabric thread and a thin black filament protruding from the seam, a shaft of pale daylight crossing the wooden floor.
subjects.cat-bowl: A black cat beside a ceramic bowl containing water, a few pale noodles and a corner of folded wet paper. A small tuft of black fur on floor, two faint overlapping shadows, muted warm apartment lamplight.
subjects.escape: A narrow shaft of afternoon sunlight falls across a closed wardrobe. A match held by an unseen person ignites a tiny black thread OUTSIDE the cabinet. A distant stairwell doorway stands ajar in the background. Small controlled flame, no blaze.
subjects.home: A warm but subdued apartment doorway at morning, a mother in a faded blue blouse embraces her child seen only from behind, a black cat at their feet. The apartment looks peaceful after a long ordeal. Painterly faces without detailed identity.
subjects.stairs: A long old apartment stairwell descending toward a quiet courtyard full of pale morning light. An open door at bottom, worn railings, release from oppressive darkness, no people.
subjects.living: An aging grey green apartment living room with worn sofa, several slightly displaced cushions, peeling damp wallpaper and an old warm table lamp. The room seems occupied but nobody is visible. A dark wardrobe beyond doorway.
subjects.day-door: Daytime knocking: view from inside the old apartment entrance, dark wooden front door, brass peephole with a faint silhouette of a middle-aged man with unnaturally tilted head, pale daylight and dust.
